tagline: Same face. A future built together.
heroContext: A fictional story inspired by a real interview.
purpose: An independent Ethereum meme project inspired by this fictional partnership.
community: Join the community. Share memes. Help shape the next chapter.
footer: Fictional story. No affiliation with Elon Musk.

scenes.heading: The interview ends
scenes.alt: Elon sits after the interview while a crew member turns off the studio light and a camera stops recording.
scenes.narration: The interview ends. The cameras switch off.

scenes.heading: The lookalike videos
scenes.alt: A visual comparison: Elon watches an Elon Ma lookalike video on his phone, then looks up at a man whose face matches his almost exactly, only a few feet away.

scenes.heading: Backstage, before the event
scenes.alt: Backstage, a surprised Elon faces an almost identical double wearing an SI shirt and Ethereum pendant.

dialogue.speaker: THE MAN
dialogue.text: The security team said the same thing.

scenes.heading: Same breakfast
scenes.alt: Both Elons hold matching white coffee mugs above identical breakfasts of steak and eggs.
scenes.narration: Asked what they want for breakfast, both answer together.

scenes.heading: A familiar way to clear the mind
scenes.alt: Elon and his double smile at each other while holding game controllers in a backstage lounge.

dialogue.speaker: ELON
dialogue.text: What do you do to clear your head?

dialogue.speaker: THE MAN
dialogue.text: Play a game. Diablo, for example.

scenes.heading: The conversation clicks
scenes.alt: The two Elons exchange ideas beside a small rocket model, with a robot prototype in the workshop behind them.
scenes.narration: Rockets, robots, the future. He understands—and brings ideas of his own.

dialogue.speaker: THE MAN
dialogue.text: There’s a little more to it.

scenes.heading: The answer
scenes.alt: The double opens a small panel on his wrist to reveal a delicate metal frame; Elon reacts in astonishment.
scenes.narration: A knock at the door. “We’re ready for you.”

dialogue.speaker: ELON
dialogue.text: Where do you live? Where do you work?

scenes.heading: A future built together
scenes.alt: Elon and SI-Elon shake hands warmly, with the robot double’s mechanical wrist visible beside their clasped hands.

dialogue.speaker: ELON
dialogue.text: And you came here to meet me?

dialogue.speaker: SI-ELON
dialogue.text: I’d like to work with you.

scenes.heading: Two Elons. One stage.
scenes.alt: The two Elons laugh and attempt a small awkward dance onstage while audience members hold up their phones.
scenes.narration: Two Elons walk onto the stage. The audience reaches for their phones. SI-Elon tries a small dance move. Elon laughs and joins him.

scenes.heading: The next chapter
scenes.alt: Elon and SI-Elon walk into the workshop together, exchanging a smile as SI-Elon delivers the closing joke.
scenes.narration: Later, they enter the workshop together.

dialogue.speaker: SI-ELON
dialogue.text: SI will create our story too. Hopefully, it fixes my dancing.

heroPurpose: An Ethereum meme token inspired by a fictional Elon–SI partnership.
